first_email.subject: Your North Austin home search
first_email.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for reaching out about buying in North Austin. You mentioned a budget of $425,000 and a preference for a manageable commute. I can help you narrow the search around the priorities that matter to you. Which feature would you put first: space, commute, or condition?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

budget.purpose: desired sale price, not a valuation

first_email.subject: Planning a possible sale in West Raleigh
first_email.body:
Hi Maya,

Our mutual contact said you may be considering selling in West Raleigh. You mentioned hoping for $520,000, which we would need to evaluate against your property and relevant sales before treating it as a price recommendation. What timing are you considering for a move?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

first_email.subject: Following up after the open house
first_email.body:
Hi Ethan,

It was good to connect at the open house. You mentioned South Tampa and a $360,000 budget. I can help clarify what matters most in your next home before we discuss any specific properties. What did you like most about the home you visited?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

budget.purpose: desired sale price, not a valuation

first_email.subject: Your East Denver valuation request
first_email.body:
Hi Marcus,

Thank you for requesting information about selling in East Denver. You entered $680,000 as your target, but I have not completed a valuation. A useful starting point is understanding the home and your plans. What would you most like to understand about the selling process?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

first_email.subject: Getting started with your Madison move
first_email.body:
Hi Lena,

Thanks for your relocation inquiry. You mentioned Downtown Madison, a $290,000 budget, and a move related to work. We can start by identifying the parts of the area that fit your routine without rushing into a property decision. What is your biggest concern about the move?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

first_email.subject: A starting point for buying in Cary
first_email.body:
Hi Noah,

Thanks for downloading the buyer guide. You noted Cary and a $475,000 budget. The first step is to understand your priorities and where you are in the buying process. What would make a home feel like the right fit for you?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: Thanks, this sounds good. I would like to talk about what to do first.

budget.purpose: desired sale price, not a valuation

first_email.subject: Thinking about selling in Round Rock
first_email.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for connecting through your neighbor. You mentioned possibly selling in Round Rock and a target of $460,000. We would need to review the home before discussing a pricing recommendation. What would you want the sale to help you accomplish?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: Yes, interested. We would like to get a better idea of the process.

first_email.subject: Your Fort Collins buying plans
first_email.body:
Hi Sofia,

It was nice meeting you at the community event. You mentioned looking in Fort Collins with a $410,000 budget. I can help you organize the search around your priorities when you have time. Which part of the buying process would you like help with first?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: Yes please. We still want to find something, just have been busy.
desired_tone: warm, patient, easy to reply to

first_email.subject: Your Portland condo questions
first_email.body:
Hi Caleb,

Thanks for asking about a condo search on Portland’s east side. You shared a $395,000 purchase budget. There is no specific property or HOA information in your inquiry yet, so we should confirm ongoing costs before discussing any particular condo. What monthly housing cost would feel comfortable to you?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: Before going further, are HOA fees included in my budget, and do you know what they are?

budget.purpose: desired sale price, not a valuation

first_email.subject: Discussing a sale in Arlington
first_email.body:
Hi Grace,

Thanks for your interest in selling in Arlington. You mentioned a target of $740,000. We have not reviewed your property, agreed on services, or discussed any commission terms. What matters most to you when choosing an agent for the sale?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: What do you charge, and what services are included?

first_email.subject: Your next step as a first-time buyer
first_email.body:
Hi Isaac,

Thanks for joining the first-time buyer workshop. You noted Charlotte’s south side and a $335,000 budget. You do not need to have every step figured out before asking questions, and your financing status has not been confirmed. What part of getting started feels least clear?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: Do I need preapproval before we talk? I have not contacted a lender yet.

first_email.subject: Your Albuquerque home inquiry
first_email.body:
Hi Chloe,

Thank you for your portal message. Your preferences show northeast Albuquerque and a $310,000 budget, but the message did not include a property address or listing identifier. I cannot confirm a particular home’s status from that information. Which property were you asking about?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: Can you confirm whether that home is still available? I cannot remember its address.

first_email.subject: Planning ahead for Tacoma
first_email.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for your inquiry about buying in Tacoma. You shared a $380,000 budget and said you are currently renting. We can approach this at a pace that fits your plans. What would you like to know before deciding when to begin?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: We are not ready yet. Probably next spring after our lease ends.

budget.purpose: desired sale price, not a valuation

first_email.subject: Your Boise selling plans
first_email.body:
Hi Avery,

Thanks for connecting about a possible sale on the Boise Bench. You mentioned a $490,000 target and renovations in progress. The timing and eventual pricing would need to be reviewed when you have more information. What would be most helpful as you plan the next steps?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: We have decided to wait until our renovation is finished. No date yet.

first_email.subject: Checking in on your Richmond search
first_email.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for writing about buying in Richmond’s West End. You noted a $345,000 budget and wanted to understand the process before choosing homes. We can begin with the questions that matter most to you. What would you like help sorting out?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: My job situation changed. I want to pause buying for now.

budget.purpose: desired sale price, not a valuation

first_email.subject: Your family’s Savannah property plans
first_email.body:
Hi Nora,

Thank you for contacting me about a possible sale in Savannah’s historic district. You mentioned a $610,000 target and that several family members are involved in the decision. Nothing needs to be decided before everyone is ready. What information would help your family discuss the options?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: The family has not agreed whether to sell. We need more time to decide.

first_email.subject: A search that fits your Mesa budget
first_email.body:
Hi Lucas,

Thanks for asking about buying in Mesa. You shared a firm maximum of $275,000. We can use that limit when discussing your priorities, without assuming you want to spend more. Which home features are essential for you?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: I cannot go above $275,000. Please do not suggest stretching the budget.

first_email.subject: Understanding your Columbus buying priorities
first_email.body:
Hi Emma,

Thanks for the introduction. You mentioned Columbus’s north side and a $225,000 purchase budget. Ongoing costs such as taxes and insurance have not been estimated for a specific home. What would you most like to understand before starting a search?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: Even if the purchase price fits, I am worried about monthly costs. I do not know the taxes or insurance yet.
desired_tone: clear, reassuring, careful about financial unknowns

budget.purpose: desired sale price, not a valuation

first_email.subject: Planning your San Antonio sale
first_email.body:
Hi Henry,

Thanks for downloading the seller checklist. You shared a $330,000 target for a possible sale in northwest San Antonio. I have not evaluated the home or comparable sales, so that amount is your goal rather than a pricing recommendation. What is your main concern about selling?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: I do not want to lower my asking price just to get attention. Can you explain how you would approach pricing?

first_email.subject: Following up on your Wichita home search
first_email.body:
Hi Zoe,

Thanks for visiting the open house. You mentioned Wichita’s east side, a $195,000 budget, and a preference for a home that needs little work. No particular home’s condition or total ownership costs have been verified. What would you consider a manageable next step in your search?

Best,
{{realtor_name}}

reply_text: We are still interested but cannot afford surprises or repairs. The budget needs to cover everything.
